lines.1: Day two of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.
lines.2: The result was a complete disaster.
lines.3: 「Honestly, every last one of you looks pathetic.」
lines.4: Partly because our class wasn't working together, the East Army, including Class 2-A, beat us.
lines.5: 「Naturally. We weren't going to lose to them, Sensei. Now, about that ramen prize.」
lines.6: Class A clapped hands and celebrated.
lines.7: During the third-year hero interview, Otome from the East Army spoke with obvious pride.
lines.8: 「We just don't have much team spirit, do we?」
lines.9: Was it because the class rep who normally held us together had all her attention fixed on me?
lines.10: That very Yoshimi went walking toward the student council area.
lines.11: Maybe she was going to refill her barley tea.
lines.12: 「All right. Time for her boyfriend to do something nice for her.」
lines.13: I went ahead and waited for Yoshimi at a spot where no one was around.
lines.14: There she was. All right, hide.
lines.16: She's coming this way... five... four... three... two... one.
lines.18: I casually threw my arms around her!
lines.20: 「Tsushima-kun... what do you think you're doing? Want to die? Though if you had to die, I can understand wanting to touch me first.」
lines.21: H-huh? That arrogant opinion could only mean--
lines.22: 「P-Princess!? When did you switch places with her?!」
lines.25: This was bad. She was glaring at me like a raging fire.
lines.27: The Princess broke free from my arms and--
lines.31: I took a brutal axe kick.
lines.32: My vision went dark and I dropped to one knee.
lines.34: 「Y-yeah... I saw Yoshimi and thought I'd surprise her... Ow...」
lines.35: 「I know. I was walking ahead of Ellie until a moment ago, so I understand it was an accident.」
lines.36: 「And I'm really happy you were trying to do that to me.」
lines.37: 「If you understand, that's all that matters.」
lines.38: 「But... when you realized the person you'd grabbed was Ellie, you looked awfully happy, Leo.」
lines.39: 「What does that mean...? Why were you so happy it was Ellie...?」
lines.41: 「It was a misunderstanding. Can't you let something that small go?」
lines.44: 「You're part of the problem too, Ellie. Stop making eyes at Leo.」
lines.45: 「What!? When have I ever made eyes at this guy?」
lines.47: 「Besides, Yoppi, you're overreacting way too much.」
lines.48: 「Ellie... Why would you say that? Aren't you on my side?」
lines.49: 「I am. I swear it on our promise.」
lines.51: 「Then I'm sorry, but could you stop talking to Leo from now on?」
lines.54: 「Don't try to control what I do too. I won't steal Tsushima-kun, who belongs to you. But I'm not going to ignore him either.」
lines.55: 「I do what I want. That's all.」
lines.57: 「Don't make that scary face. Smile, smile! You've got such a cute face.」
lines.58: 「If you just fixed that negative way of thinking, Yoppi, you'd be an even more wonderful girl.」
lines.60: The Princess gently patted Yoshimi's head.
lines.61: 「Anyway, I'm not someone who moves because another person orders me around. Since it's you, Yoppi, I'll keep what you said in mind.」
lines.62: 「Look, your boyfriend's standing there all alone and stunned.」
lines.68: 「...I'm going to the bathroom. See you later.」
lines.72: 「Ellie really is beautiful... She sparkles, she carries herself proudly, and she's bursting with energy. I guess I can't blame Leo for looking at her.」
lines.73: 「What am I supposed to do...? I can't become happy like this.」
lines.77: 「Ahaha... Ahahaha... Ahahahaha! It was so... so, so simple.」
lines.78: 「Ellie just has to stop being beautiful.」
lines.82: 「You've barely said anything since last night.」
lines.83: 「So? After watching me for a week, what did you think?」
lines.86: There'd been an accident or two, but all that effort had paid off.
lines.87: 「Then we should have no problem keeping this going.」
lines.90: 「Ellie... I'm going to show you the truth about Ellie.」
lines.92: 「Ellie isn't as perfect as you think she is, Leo. I'll show you that now.」
lines.93: 「Hide inside the wardrobe. I'm going to call Ellie over, and then you can see the truth.」
lines.95: 「Because! You only know Ellie's beautiful side! You've only seen how cool she is!」
lines.96: 「I'll show you the hopelessly ordinary-girl side of her. Then you won't look at Ellie with those sparkling eyes anymore.」
lines.97: 「I don't really get it, but are you trying to set a trap for the Princess?」
lines.98: 「If I ask, Ellie will come over gladly. She'll do it for me.」
